test-canonical-overlap.R compares this package's function names against isochrones/twostep/cliff/mufflyaccess checkouts beside it. They are separate repositories, absent from CI and from <pkg>.Rcheck/, so the gate can only run on a developer machine with the siblings cloned. It skips rather than passing vacuously; scripts/dev/audit_canonical_overlap.R is the same check runnable by hand.

test-access-ascertainment.R needs artifacts/access_ascertainment/provider_flow_fpmrs.csv, a generated provider-flow funnel derived from NPI-bearing data. It is not in git and is not built in CI, so the funnel-accounting gates skip; they run where the artifact has been generated.

test-entry-panel.R's database-backed panel test needs the local NBER DuckDB at ENTRY_PANEL_DB_DEFAULT (a developer external drive), never present in CI. It skips there and runs where the DB is attached.

test-transport-to-national.R and test-pop-encounter-estimand.R read the CHIA Case Mix DuckDB at a developer external drive. The source .mdb files are DUA-restricted and cannot be redistributed, so this can never run in CI.
